description: Machine-readable catalog of SKU.io outbound webhook events. Subscribe via POST /api/webhook-subscriptions (scope: webhooks:manage). Deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw JSON body; hex digest in the X-SKU-Signature header as 'sha256=<hex>', using the whsec_-prefixed secret shown once at subscription creation.

delivery.deactivation: HTTP 410 from the receiver deactivates the subscription immediately; 25 consecutive failures deactivate it and notify the account.
delivery.rate_cap: 600 outbound deliveries/min per tenant; excess deliveries are dropped, not queued.
delivery.ordering: Not guaranteed — use occurred_at and delivery_id to de-duplicate and order.

events.fires_when: A sales order is created (any channel or manual)
A sales order is fully fulfilled / shipped
A sales order is cancelled (manual or channel-sync)
A purchase order is submitted to the supplier
Goods are received against a purchase order
Inventory levels are adjusted (manual or system)
A product is created (UI, API, or import)
A customer is created (manual or first-seen-from-channel)
